title: console-tooling-standup-2026-07-07
content:
Date: 2026-07-07
Attendees: Ava, Jordan, Luis, Priya, Maya (remote)
Duration: 25m

SUMMARY
- Quick sync on UI polish, rollout automation, and analytics backfill.
- Main focus this sprint: finish rollout policy editor v1, fix top-priority latency regression in workflows list, and ship analytics backfill pipeline for rollout exposure metrics.

UPDATES
1) UI (Ava / Jordan)
- PR #482 merged to add inline validation to rollout policy editor (conditions/weights). UX feedback addressed: move advanced options behind toggle.
- Remaining: keyboard accessibility tweaks and adding tooltip copy for traffic split. Estimated 2 days.
- Investigating a sporadic layout shift on small screens — likely CSS timing with the skeleton loader. Action: Jordan to try reducing skeleton height / replace with placeholder box.
- NOTE: We still need a11y audit ticket (JIRA-ACC-92).

2) Rollouts backend & orchestration (Luis)
- Canary rollout engine: implemented exponential ramp helper, currently in integration testing.
- Found an edge case where fallback rules didn't trigger when model variant labels were similar — added a normalization step. Added unit tests.
- Load test yesterday: throughput looked good up to 120 req/s, latency tail at 99p increased by ~40ms when cache miss rate hit 30%. Probable cause: KV cache pressure on instance pools.
- Action: Ops to collect per-instance KV hit/miss metrics next 48h (PR sent to infra team, referenced in linked artifacts).

3) Analytics & metrics (Priya / Maya)
- Rolling out backfill pipeline for rollout exposure and feature-flag usage (Spark job + incremental migration). First run succeeded for a 2-week window; discovered timestamp timezone mismatch for events from EU region.
- Fix deployed: normalize to UTC at ingestion. Next full backfill scheduled for 2026-07-09.
- Dashboard: added a rollout-exposure panel to Console -> Rollouts. Still missing cohort breakdown by customer tier.
- Action: Priya to open dashboard PR and ask design for small layout change.

BLOCKERS / RISKS
- Latency regression observed under moderate burst traffic (see load test notes). Risk: impacts interactive users on low-tier plans. Mitigation: temporary auto-fallback to smaller model or lower batch size; rollout of this fallback requires a quick canary policy.
- Analytics backfill: timezone mismatch blocked full run; fixed but need to verify completeness. If backfill takes >24h, dashboards will be stale for customer checks.
- Rollout policy editor: keyboard/a11y items block ship for accessibility audit. If audit fails, we may need a small patch release.

DECISIONS / AGREEMENTS
- Proceed with shipping rollout policy editor v1 next week but gate GA on passing a short a11y checklist (Ava + Jordan to own).
- Temporarily enable model-variant fallback for affected lower-tier customers while we investigate KV cache pressure (Luis to coordinate with infra).

ACTION ITEMS (owners)
- Jordan: CSS skeleton fix + open small PR for keyboard focus order (ETA 2026-07-09).
- Luis: Add per-instance KV hit/miss metrics to infra dashboard and follow up with SRE (ETA 48h).
- Priya: Dashboard PR for rollout-exposure panel + cohort breakdown request to design (ETA 2026-07-10).
- Ava: Prepare a11y checklist and schedule quick audit with R&D accessibility owner (ETA 2026-07-08).
- Maya: Run full backfill on 2026-07-09 and verify completeness; report anomalies.

NOTES / TODOs
- Link follow-ups in this doc to JIRA tickets when created.
- Remind support to update customers about potential minor UI tweaks during rollout UI GA.
- Consider adding a synthetic test that simulates KV cache misses during CI load tests.

NEXT MEETING
- Weekly standup: 2026-07-14 10:00am PT.

MISC (notes to self, informal)
- Sketch: might explore a compact table for rollout rules to reduce vertical space.
- Quick thought: could we reuse existing prefix-cache code for rollout-engine KV caching to reduce duplication? Luis to evaluate.

End of notes.
